news.title: Mastercard Launches UK AI Sandbox to Accelerate Payments Innovation for Banks and Retailers
news.body: Mastercard is launching an AI sandbox in the UK designed to let banks and retailers test and deploy advanced AI-driven payment solutions. The company describes the sandbox as 'agentic,' meaning it enables AI systems to act autonomously within set parameters, allowing users to simulate real-world payment scenarios. This initiative gives banks and retailers a controlled environment to experiment with AI for fraud detection, personalization, and operational efficiency, potentially outpacing competitors like Visa and American Express in AI adoption. Mastercard’s move may prompt UK regulators to scrutinize AI use in payments more closely as banks and retailers roll out new AI-powered products.

news.title: AI Private Banking Startup Flex Raises $70 Million to Expand Globally
news.body: Flex, an AI-native private banking platform, has raised $70 million to support its international growth. By using AI to deliver personalized wealth management, Flex challenges established private banks such as UBS and Credit Suisse, which may need to accelerate their own digital transformation to retain high-net-worth clients. The funding will allow Flex to enhance its AI-driven insights and efficiency, potentially shifting client expectations for digital service in private banking.

news.title: Visa Debuts AI Assistant for US Banks to Boost Cardholder Engagement
news.body: Visa has introduced an AI assistant for US banks to integrate into their mobile apps, providing cardholders with tailored financial insights and actionable recommendations. This tool enables banks to offer more proactive spending advice and fraud alerts, raising the bar for digital engagement in banking apps. Competing networks like Mastercard and fintechs such as Chime may need to accelerate their own AI-powered features to match Visa’s enhanced customer experience.

news.title: Stablecoin Treasury Platform Velocity Raises $38 Million for Enterprise Settlement Expansion
news.body: Velocity, a stablecoin treasury and settlement platform, has secured $38 million in Series A funding led by Dragonfly and FirstMark. The investment will help Velocity expand its blockchain-based treasury solutions for enterprises, offering faster and programmable settlement compared to legacy providers like FIS and Kyriba. As more enterprises adopt stablecoins for cross-border and B2B payments, traditional treasury vendors face increased competition from blockchain-native platforms.

news.title: Custodia Petitions Supreme Court for Federal Reserve Master Account Access
news.body: Crypto bank Custodia has petitioned the US Supreme Court after being repeatedly denied access to a Federal Reserve master account. If the Court rules in Custodia’s favor, digital asset banks could gain direct access to federal payment rails, challenging the current regulatory boundaries set by the Fed. The outcome will be closely monitored by other crypto banks and may influence future policy on digital asset institutions’ access to central banking infrastructure.

perspective: Mastercard’s UK AI sandbox and Custodia’s Supreme Court petition spotlight how incumbents and challengers are reshaping payments through technology and regulation.
